used [autoit-ripper](https://github.com/nazywam/AutoIt-Ripper) to extract a [script](stage2.au3).

Cleaned up the autoit code and rewrote [chunks.py](chunks.py) to prrint the payoad

put it in [Cyberchef](https://cyberchef.formality.de/#recipe=From_Hex('Auto')Remove_null_bytes()&oeol=CRLF)

this provides us with another [powershell payload](stage3.ps1) which lets us [decode the encodedJson](https://cyberchef.formality.de/#recipe=From_Base64('A-Za-z0-9%2B/%3D',true,false)Remove_null_bytes()Regular_expression('User%20defined','flag%7B.*%7D',true,true,false,false,false,false,'List%20matches')&&oeol=CRLF) variable containing the flag
